prompt:
Scientific educational infographic for a Chinese geology teaching website. Create a NEW 4:3 landscape infographic (approximately 1536x1152), closely matching the visual grammar of a Chinese mud-logging process diagram: small isometric 3D toy-scale industrial workstations, tiny orange-overall hard-hat geologist figurines, soft warm ivory desert-paper background, pastel color coded process panels, compact dense explanatory Chinese labels, thick pastel flow ribbons. It must look like a technical miniature model diagram, NOT a photographic collage, NOT four large landscape photos, NOT UI or a website screenshot.
Composition is precise:
Top third (y=5%-35%): a single continuous regional geological fieldwork scene: small satellite scans exposed folded rock hills at left, shallow soil sampling grid and small mobile chemical lab near center, paper geological map archive and drone/outcrop observation at right. Across top, a pale blue heading ribbon with exact Chinese "1 区域调查与资料获取". Small source labels "遥感影像" "化探采样" "历史图件" "露头照片". Fieldwork does not include oil rigs or wells.
Middle row, from y=40% to y=70%: FOUR equally-sized front-facing mini workstations in four adjacent softly colored sections with no hard separated rectangular photo frames, each having Chinese title at top, 2 short explanatory lines, and miniature equipment below. Place the four sections from left to right in these exact horizontal ranges: 2%-25%, 26%-49%, 50%-73%, 74%-98%.
Orange first section: title "g1 遥感解译：识别地表单元"; explanation "多波段与地形共同判读" and "输出岩性边界候选". Below, geologist at monitor showing multiband terrain image and colored geological segmentation map.
Blue second section: title "g2 化探异常：圈定复采区域"; explanation "多指标异常与空间聚类" and "结合道路与环境记录复核". Below, bench with tiny sample vials, chromatography instrument, and map monitor with clustered sample dots.
Purple third section: title "g3 图件提取：从像素到要素"; explanation "图面识别与注记语义关联" and "保留图例、原文和要素来源". Below, miniature flatbed scanner and desk with paper geological map, digital vector map and OCR boxes.
Green fourth section: title "g4 露头裂缝：提取线迹"; explanation "影像分割与线段统计" and "先做尺度标定，再检查几何". Below, miniature rocky outcrop face with visible fractures, tripod camera, ruler and field laptop with colored trace overlay.
Thick light blue data-distribution ribbon runs horizontally just above the four stations (y=37%-40%), with branches going down into each workstation. Beneath the four stations, four curved ribbons in orange, blue, purple and green converge towards a central mapping station in bottom third, around y=75%-98%.
Bottom center: large 3D geological map board viewed isometrically, with geological polygons, fault traces, soil sample points and a field verification notebook, tiny geologists at computer. Blue title label at left "2 统一坐标，交叉核查"; short text "影像、采样、图件与露头" "回到同一张区域地质底图". At bottom right a modest report/field verification desk with orange heading "3 形成底图与复核清单", text "保留来源与待确认区域". No fake percentage metrics.
Readable, accurate Simplified Chinese lettering in dark navy. Text is part of the scientific diagram, positioned above workstations, with no webpage navigation or buttons. Matte detailed clay/plastic miniatures, same camera angle and scale throughout, lots of visual order, carefully connected process flow, clean white-ivory open margins.
